properties.displayName: OJK - Manual attestation for Attest cryptographic keys in accordance with organization-defined requirements for generation
properties.description: Manual attestation is required to validate Manage cryptographic keys in accordance with organization-defined requirements for generation, distribution, storage, access, rotation, and destruction, with continuous monitoring and periodic reviews. (Data-Security-58).

metadata.Description:
Key Generation
for more details - refer to Control statement
Key Generation
- Implements a centralized key management system using a Hardware Security Module (HSM) that is FIPS 140-2 Level 3 certified
. This system generates strong cryptographic keys using a secure random number generator - Microsoft Managed
Key Distribution
- Keys are securely distributed to different cloud environments using encrypted channels and secure protocols
Key Storage
- Keys are stored in cloud-native key management services:
- These services are configured to use customer-managed keys (CMKs) with the Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) option
Access Control
- Only authorized personnel have access to key management functions
- Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) is enforced for all key operations
- Access is granted based on the principle of least privilege7
Key Rotation
- Symmetric keys are rotated every 90 days
- Asymmetric keys are rotated annually
- Rotation schedules are adjusted based on risk assessments for high-impact keys
Key Destruction
- When keys are no longer needed, they are immediately revoked across all cloud platforms
- Secure deletion processes are initiated to ensure complete removal
- Hardware-backed key deletion is used where available
metadata.controlTitle: Manage cryptographic keys in accordance with organization-defined requirements for generation, distribution, storage, access, rotation, and destruction, with continuous monitoring and periodic reviews.
